sources.title: Muse Glimmer — Meta's 30B Open Agentic Model | AI/TLDR
sources.snippet: Muse Glimmer is Meta's Apache-2.0 30B agentic multimodal model, distilled from Muse Spark to run locally on one consumer GPU. Released August 10, 2026.

sources.title: Muse Glimmer 30B: An On-Device Agentic Model - ai.meta.com
sources.snippet: Abstract We introduce Muse Glimmer, an open-source 30B parameter causal language model with perception encoder, purpose-built for autonomous agentic tasks on consumer hardware. Muse Glimmer integrates multi-step reasoning, reliable tool use and failure recovery into a single model that runs locally on consumer devices without requiring cloud infrastructure.
